  - region "Simple English explanation of Reflexive Relations":

      - heading "Understand Reflexive Relations" [level=2]
  - text: CLASS 11 · RELATIONS AND FUNCTIONS
  - heading "Reflexive Relations" [level=1]
  - paragraph: A relation R on a set A is reflexive if every element is related to itself.
  - navigation: 18 min ADVANCED CONCEPT graph matrix
  - complementary:
    - text: Definition
    - paragraph: R is reflexive on A if and only if
    - strong: ∀ a ∈ A, (a,a) ∈ R
  - main:
    - heading "RELATION EDITOR" [level=2]
    - text: "Set A = {1, 2, 3, 4}"
    - button "Edit set":
      - img
      - text: Edit set
    - paragraph: Toggle an ordered pair (a,b) to include or remove it from R.
    - navigation:
      - button "Graph"
      - button "Matrix"
    - article:
      - heading "DIRECTED GRAPH OF R" [level=2]
      - img "Reflexive relation graph":
        - button "Toggle self-pair 1": "1"
        - button "Toggle self-pair 2": "2"
        - button "Toggle self-pair 3": "3"
        - button "Toggle self-pair 4": "4"
      - text: → In R (included) --- Not in R (excluded)
    - article:
      - heading "ADJACENCY MATRIX Mᵣ" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Mᵣ[i,j] = 1 if (i,j) ∈ R, else 0.
      - text: − 1 2 3 4 1
      - button "Toggle relation 1, 1": "0"
      - button "Toggle relation 1, 2": "1"
      - button "Toggle relation 1, 3": "0"
      - button "Toggle relation 1, 4": "1"
      - text: "2"
      - button "Toggle relation 2, 1": "0"
      - button "Toggle relation 2, 2": "1"
      - button "Toggle relation 2, 3": "1"
      - button "Toggle relation 2, 4": "0"
      - text: "3"
      - button "Toggle relation 3, 1": "1"
      - button "Toggle relation 3, 2": "0"
      - button "Toggle relation 3, 3": "1"
      - button "Toggle relation 3, 4": "0"
      - text: "4"
      - button "Toggle relation 4, 1": "0"
      - button "Toggle relation 4, 2": "1"
      - button "Toggle relation 4, 3": "0"
      - button "Toggle relation 4, 4": "1"
      - paragraph: Click a cell to toggle (i,j).
      - img
      - text: Diagonal cells (i,i) represent self-pairs.
    - button "Add all self-pairs Add (a,a) for all a ∈ A":
      - img
      - text: Add all self-pairs Add (a,a) for all a ∈ A
    - button "Test Reflexive Check if R is reflexive on A":
      - img
      - text: Test Reflexive Check if R is reflexive on A
    - complementary:
      - heading "REFLEXIVE CHECKER" [level=2]
      - img
      - strong: Not Reflexive
      - paragraph: "Missing self-pair: (1, 1)"
      - paragraph: The following self-pairs must be in R.
      - table:
        - rowgroup:
          - row "a Self-pair (a,a) Status":
            - columnheader "a"
            - columnheader "Self-pair (a,a)"
            - columnheader "Status"
        - rowgroup:
          - row "1 (1, 1) × Missing":
            - cell "1"
            - cell "(1, 1)"
            - cell "× Missing"
          - row "2 (2, 2) ✓ Present":
            - cell "2"
            - cell "(2, 2)"
            - cell "✓ Present"
          - row "3 (3, 3) ✓ Present":
            - cell "3"
            - cell "(3, 3)"
            - cell "✓ Present"
          - row "4 (4, 4) ✓ Present":
            - cell "4"
            - cell "(4, 4)"
            - cell "✓ Present"
      - article:
        - text: How it works
        - paragraph: R is reflexive on A if every a ∈ A has a self-loop in the graph (diagonal cell = 1 in the matrix). The checker highlights the first missing witness.
  - text: Best classroom move
  - paragraph: Predict the result before changing the model. Try removing a diagonal entry and see which witness fails first.
